_approach: A busier hat-forward variant: the closed hat runs a full accented 16th wall (velocity contour rising into each beat) while the offbeat open hat is choked hard and short, and a tambourine doubles the offbeat for extra shimmer — the dense-hat construction some classic trance productions favour over the sparser progressive pocket. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
